title: Privacy Policy
intro: What we collect, why we collect it, and what we never do with it.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, email, phone number and delivery address when you place an order, and basic usage data that helps us keep the site working.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: To process and deliver your order, send order updates on WhatsApp, and answer support requests. Nothing more.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Card and UPI details are handled entirely by our payment gateway on their own secure page. We never see or store your payment details.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We share your address with our delivery partner so your order can reach you. We do not sell your data to anyone.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask us to correct or delete your data at any time by emailing us.
